accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1 — thm:sharp-sign-ratio-closure
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Reverse attainment and equality are conditional on the stated nonsingular jointly Gaussian observed-law submodel; arbitrary observed laws receive containment only.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Sharp over the stated jointly Gaussian observed-law family, with unrestricted admissible cross-setting covariance; not universal non-Gaussian sharpness.

The article gives bootstrap calibrated-projection confidence intervals with uniform asymptotic coverage for finite-dimensional moment-(in)equality models via repeated feasibility checks.

For a Gaussian first-stage limit, ordinary-bootstrap consistency is equivalent to full differentiability under the theorem's conditions, and an alternative resampling scheme is developed for directionally differentiable maps.

The numerical-derivative delta method gives consistent inference for directionally differentiable functions under an appropriate step-size sequence and uniform validity for certain convex Lipschitz functions.
